core_claim: Sixty years of orbital launches show that by 2018 the space race was no longer a race between superpowers — it was a market, and the leaders of 1985 had been almost entirely displaced by entrants that did not yet exist.

edt_01.label: The 1982 / 2018 inversion
edt_01.editorial_notes: Lead the page. The 108→10 inversion (Soviet 1982 vs. Russia 2018) and the 28/27/17/10 numbers (China/US/SpaceX/Russia in 2018) must be exact and prominent.

edt_02.label: The long arc, 1957-2018
edt_02.title: The long arc
edt_02.editorial_notes: Show the 1967 peak (139), 2004 trough (53), and 1991 turning point. Embed the 95.6% Cold War duopoly figure inline.

edt_03.label: The bloc handover
edt_03.title: The bloc handover
edt_03.editorial_notes: The bloc-stacked-area or stream chart is the visual centerpiece of this section. Reader should be able to scrub a year-slider or hover any year to see the 4-bloc breakdown.

edt_04.label: State retreat, private surge
edt_04.title: From state to market
edt_04.editorial_notes: 1984 first private launch and 2000 cross-over need to be visible on the chart. ana_caveat_05 (startups = SpaceX+Rocket Lab) belongs in this section's footer.

edt_05.label: SpaceX in fast-forward
edt_05.title: SpaceX in fast-forward
edt_05.editorial_notes: The cumulative SpaceX line (1→68 in 12 years) is the signature visual. Could pair with image (Falcon 9 first stage landing on a drone ship). ana_caveat_05 caveat applies here too.

edt_06.label: Failure rates
edt_06.title: Learning to land
edt_06.editorial_notes: 53.8% → 3% over six decades is striking. Note the counter-intuitive ordering: private (2.6%) < state (6.6%) < startup (7.1%).

edt_07.label: Geography
edt_07.title: A geography that has barely moved
edt_07.editorial_notes: Optional section. ana_13 launch-site coordinates are externally annotated, not from raw data — caveat ana_caveat_02 must be visible. If map is too brittle, skip the map and use only the bar chart of ana_14.

edt_08.label: What replaces a duopoly
edt_08.editorial_notes: End on tension and interpretation, not a summary. The 12-operator 2018 leaderboard is the closing visual.
